en.t: I made sure there was no one nearby.

units.source_text: 摔跤场那边响起了一片喊声。

en.t: A burst of shouting rose from the sumo ring.

units.source_text: 我从兜里掏出生了锈的铅笔刀，悄悄走了过去，

en.t: I pulled a rusty pencil knife from my pocket and quietly walked over,

units.source_text: 在美丽的短剑黑剑鞘里侧，深深地划了两三道难看的刀痕……

en.t: and on the inside of the beautiful dagger's black sheath, I carved two or three deep, ugly cuts...
